title: Install InBrowser.App
description: Choose the browser you use to get installation instructions.

ios-safari: Open this page in Safari and tap Share. If you do not see Share, open the page menu or the More menu first.
In the Share menu, tap View More if needed, then Add to Home Screen. If Open as Web App appears, turn it on.
Tap Add, then open InBrowser.App from your Home Screen.
ios-other: Open the browser’s Share menu, usually beside the address bar.
If Add to Home Screen is available, tap it and confirm. Turn on Open as Web App if you see that option.
If the option is missing or you opened this page inside another app, open inbrowser.app in Safari and follow the Safari guide.
android-chrome: Open the Chrome menu (⋮) and choose Install and create shortcut.
Choose Install and follow the prompts. On some versions, look for Install app or Add to Home screen in the main menu.
android-firefox: Open the Firefox menu (⋮) and tap Install.
Tap Add automatically or drag the icon to a spot on your Home screen.
android-samsung-internet: Tap the install icon in the address bar if you see one.
You can also open the Samsung Internet menu and choose Add page to, then Home screen. Follow the prompts.
android-other: Look in your browser menu for Install, Add to Home screen, or Add to Phone. If you have a choice, select Install.
If the option is missing or you opened the site inside another app, use Open in browser if available. You can also open inbrowser.app in Chrome and follow the Chrome guide.
desktop-chrome: Click the install icon in the address bar if you see one.
You can also open the Chrome menu, choose Cast, save, and share, then Install page as app. Confirm to install.
desktop-edge: Click the app install icon in the address bar if you see one.
You can also open Settings and more, then More tools, Apps, and Install this site as an app. Confirm to install.
macos-safari: Open this page in Safari on macOS Sonoma 14 or later.
Choose File, then Add to Dock. You can also find Add to Dock under Share in the toolbar.
Click Add, then open InBrowser.App from the Dock or Applications.
windows-firefox: Open this page in a regular Firefox window. Use Firefox 143 or later, or version 150 or later if installed from the Microsoft Store.
Click the web apps button in the address bar. Open InBrowser.App from the taskbar or Start menu.
